data.spec: apps/speech/speaker_id.py CLI: additive subcommands `team [--names ...] [--seconds N] [--keep]` (guided enrollment of Leo, Noah, Jørgen, Anders plus a test round, then calibration) and `calibrate` (re-learns threshold from stored samples). `list` also prints the active threshold. Threshold now defaults to the calibrated value stored in .data/voiceprints.json (fallback 0.70); `--threshold` default is None (override only). Stored file adds `threshold` and `normalize` fields.
